label: AUTHORITATIVE spread-sign verification. Measured twice, once after a user correction. This supersedes any corpus statement.
filter: REG 2017 W1 - 2026 W5, margin = home_score - away_score, n = 2462
RULE: mu = +spread_line on nflverse. DO NOT FLIP.

evidence.correlation_sign: positive -> spread_line tracks the home margin

CORRECTION_TO_A_COMMON_MISSTATEMENT.verdict: TRUE ONLY UNDER THE WRONG CONVENTION. It is the tell-tale of the flipped sign.
CORRECTION_TO_A_COMMON_MISSTATEMENT.why: nflverse spread_line = +3.5 means the HOME team is getting 3.5. The line the home team must beat is -3.5, so with mu = +3.5 they clear it 69.86% of the time. The 50% cover figure only appears when mu is flipped.
CORRECTION_TO_A_COMMON_MISSTATEMENT.the_useful_part: P(home win) = 0.6027 under the correct convention matches the quoted 'win 60.3%' exactly. It is the cover figure paired with it that was inverted.

proof_row.reading: KC (away) favoured by 8, won by 15. mu = +8 vs realized -15 is the correct error. mu = -8 would predict NE by 8 against a 15-point KC win.

where_the_wrong_convention_lives: The corpus, ~8 places: PREDICTION_ENGINE_MASTER (1)/(2).md, GSE_MASTER_PACK_2026-10-10 (1).md, GSE_HANDOFF_PACK_2026-10-10 (1).md, gse-deep-nfl-methods-corpus-2026.md
IN-REPO: docs/predictions/research/2026-10-13/SKILL.md:22 and :48, and CODING_AGENT_PROMPT_EXACT.md:18 -- these teach mu_margin = -listed_spread and must be annotated
Sports Engine and Glicko2 Audit.docx: 'residual = home_margin + listed_spread where listed spread is the bookmaker's home line (favorite < 0)'
why_those_are_not_simply_wrong: They are correct for a BOOK's home-number feed. nflverse's spread_line is the away team's number. The formula is right; the data column it was pointed at is different. Any code adopting mu = -listed_spread MUST first assert which team the incoming spread refers to.
related_convention_that_inherits_the_dep: team_total_split: home = (game_total + mu_margin)/2, away = (game_total - mu_margin)/2. The corpus already notes the original (T+spread)/2 made the favourite score LESS -- a real sign error caught earlier.
